method: Independent visual inspection of unaltered full-resolution PNG frames decoded from the actual MP4 at 1fps; independent full video decode and every-frame PTS verification. Original MP4 not reencoded or modified. Frame filenames identify fps-filter samples, not exact key press times. Action times are source metadata offsets relative to the first captured frame.
cursor: Actual blinking block; do not describe as steady. Visible filled blocks make both line boundaries and pane focus legible during the holds.
cleanShells: No macOS Bash deprecation advisory or stray setup input appears in the inspected Terminal 1, Terminal 2, or Terminal 3 checkpoint frames. Terminal 2 and 3 show their complete fixture labels and clean QA> prompts.

actions.label: Two panes ready; Terminal 3 is active

observations.observation: CmdLeft visibly places the filled block over the first e of echo. Following sampled frames show the blink off phase while command text and key caption remain unchanged for the hold.
CmdRight visibly places the filled block immediately after two. Following samples show the blink off phase, with no text change during the hold.
The repeated CmdLeft again places the filled block on the first e before prefix typing starts.
After the assignment prefix has been inserted before echo, CmdRight visibly places the block after two, at the end of the complete command.
Enter executes the edited command and visibly prints one two ok, followed by a fresh QA> prompt.
Terminal 1 remains left; Terminal 2 and Terminal 3 are distinct stable tabs on the right, with Terminal 3 selected and a clean TERMINAL THREE / QA> shell display.
OptionShift[ selects Terminal 2 on the right and changes the terminal content to TERMINAL TWO with a clean QA> prompt.
OptionShift] returns to Terminal 3, whose content is TERMINAL THREE and a clean QA> prompt.
CmdShiftLeft visibly focuses Terminal 1: active tab emphasis and filled prompt cursor move left; Terminal 3 has an outline cursor.
CmdShiftRight visibly returns focus to Terminal 3: filled cursor is on the right, outline cursor remains left.
CmdOptionShiftLeft moves the actual Terminal 3 tab and TERMINAL THREE content into the left pane. Terminal 2 and TERMINAL TWO remain on the right.
CmdOptionShiftRight moves Terminal 3 and its content back right, restoring Terminal 1 output on the left. The final capture preserves the three-second ending hold.
